The infinite-mean construction depends on a threshold choice unsupported by the target's motivating picture. Hold A6 as research material, not a current submission candidate.

## Selection implication

E1, E2, and E3 remain the mature preparation set, not an endorsed final three. E2 now has a separate externally revised option whose provenance must be disclosed. O4 and O5 require further substantive review before replacing one of those entries. There is no basis for calling any new version prize-ready on the strength of author-written revision notes alone.

The next useful work is review of E2 v5 and O5 v3, plus a focused O4 adequacy rewrite if pursued. No new broad candidate pool is needed. Nothing has been submitted.
